_comment: VARIETYSTRUCTUREPLAN Band 3 (B28, D4/§5) — layers a Copper Wire coil (IE) onto the FE→ME Substation's chest. Inert without Immersive Engineering: AddDropModifier resolves the id via Lookup.hasItem and adds nothing when absent. Gate-safe: a copper wire coil is an early IE component, never a high-tier blueprint or a working multiblock.
